title: Code-Grounded Agentic Explanations for Static Analysis Vulnerability Findings
abstract: arXiv:2611.13041v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Static application security testing (SAST) tools surface vulnerabilities early and their verdicts are rule-based and auditable. Yet developers routinely dismiss findings they cannot interpret. Large language models can supply the missing explanation, but designs that also hand the model the detection give up the auditability that makes static analysis defensible. We keep detection with the analyser and give the model only the explaining. A preliminary user study with 20 participants and a workshop with 19 practitioners yielded five requirements. Guided by these we redesigned SAFE, an open-source IntelliJ IDEA plugin that explains findings from any analyser reporting in the Static Analysis Results Interchange Format. It tiers explanations by demand, ties them to the reported data flow, and replaces the single-prompt backend with an agent that must consult the repository and the rule that fired before answering. A within-subjects crossov

translated_title: 基于代码依据的智能体式静态分析漏洞发现解释
translated_abstract: 静态应用安全测试（SAST）工具能够尽早发现漏洞，其判定基于规则且可审计。然而，开发者常常会忽略那些他们无法理解的结果。大语言模型可以提供缺失的解释，但如果设计上让模型同时负责检测，就会失去使静态分析站得住脚的可审计性。我们将检测工作保留给分析器，只让模型负责解释。一项有20名参与者参与的初步用户研究和一场有19名从业者参加的工作坊得出了五项需求。在这些需求的指导下，我们重新设计了SAFE，这是一个开源的IntelliJ IDEA插件，能够解释任何以静态分析结果交换格式（SARIF）报告结果的分析器所产生的发现。该插件按需求分层提供解释，将其与报告的数据流关联起来，并用一个智能体替换单一提示词后端，该智能体在回答之前必须查阅代码仓库和被触发的规则。一项被试内交叉实验（研究，摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出将漏洞检测职责保留给静态分析器、大语言模型智能体仅负责生成解释，并据此重新设计了开源IDE插件SAFE，要求智能体在回答前必须查阅代码仓库和触发的规则，从而在保留可审计性的同时生成有代码依据的解释。
en_tdlr: The paper keeps vulnerability detection with the static analyser and lets an LLM agent only explain findings, redesigning the open-source SAFE IntelliJ plugin so that the agent must consult the repository and the triggered rule before answering, thereby grounding explanations in code while preserving auditability.
